verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a first-party MCP server that lets Claude AI "perform a range of banking and payment operations on your behalf," which gives users natural-language operation of the product. The natural-language layer is an external assistant (Claude), though, and the only concretely documented tool is payment-link creation. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (e.g. in Console), documented breadth of operations available via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP integration works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: By integrating the TrueLayer MCP server with this AI assistant, you'd empower Claude AI to perform a range of banking and payment operations on your behalf.
create-truelayer-payment-link` - Generate a new payment link for initiating a payment from a bank account to the TrueLayer merchant account
